description: Manages various types of documents associated with different entities within the system, such as partners, projects, or interactions.

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of document types, optionally filtered by an associated entity name, with support for pagination and ordering. This endpoint allows users to fetch document types relevant to specific parts of the system, such as 'Partner' or 'Project'.

entityName.description: The name of the entity to filter document types by (e.g., 'Partner', 'Project').

pageIndex.description: The 0-based index of the page to retrieve. Defaults to 0 if not specified.

pageSize.description: The number of items per page. Defaults to 10.

orderBy.description: The field name to sort the results by (e.g., 'Name', 'Id').

ascending.description: Determines the sort order. True for ascending, false for descending. Defaults to true.

example_uses: List document types associated with the 'Partner' entity, showing 20 per page.
Retrieve document types for 'Project' entity, sorted by name in descending order.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to retrieve a list of available document types, either globally or specific to a particular entity (like 'Partner' or 'Project'), with options for pagination and sorting.
